report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with persistent fatigue that has worsened recently and is affecting daily functioning, along with a stable neck swelling that has been present for about two weeks. The symptoms began around the same time as work-related stress. The patient has a history of back surgery and takes occasional ibuprofen. They have not tried to find an explanation for their symptoms on their own and are open to medical help but hesitant due to lack of experience with this type of condition.
